items.title: The authentic native exporter and its verifier (the step-4 producer of every handoff)
items.blocks_note: Needed before the first real handoff, after step 4's FULL_FINAL_DECISION. It does not affect step 4's own start.

raised_by: Codex1 H3 (its complete-roster custody part, V003)
items.issue: FORMAL: the guarded step-4 path has no authentic, target-free producer of admitted points (HANDOFF_CONTRACT_CX1V002, 'Proposed producer'; RULES_AUDIT_CX1V001 section 4: no per-point record callback; points are published only at finalise, after two deterministic replays). The native record (CALIBRATION_RUN_RECORD_C2V003) keeps them at run.exploration.admitted_points. The native verify_calibration_record (engine L3017-3108) checks canonical bytes, self-hash, fingerprint and registry chain, but does not reclassify predictions; the freeze module's _check_calibration_record (L2919-2980) re-derives the rectangles and reclassifies members (RULES_AUDIT, 'Native layout and verifier'). TESTED by Claude3 (0094 SF4): writer v008 checks only labels, the selected point's membership and claimed hashes, so a view that holds 1 point of a 3-point roster and is labelled final passes write_point.
options: (a) A new reviewed exporter. It reads the native record and registry read-only; runs verify_calibration_record and the freeze module's reclassification unchanged; requires engine_status COMPLETE and engine_ok true (a registered BUDGET_EXHAUSTED record is not COMPLETE) and both deterministic replay results; rebuilds the complete admitted roster and compares it entry by entry (log_index, u, theta_natural) with the emitted final-decision view; then emits only those three fields per point.
(b) Root extracts the points by hand, with a checklist.
(c) Freeze v003g becomes the producer, extended to emit the export.

recommendation.label: RECOMMENDATION
recommendation.text: (a). Its tests include Codex1's named controls (a truncated roster, a relabelled final view, scope and replay mismatches, a forged or swapped record, a BUDGET_EXHAUSTED record) and Claude3's 1-of-3 case, all as MUST_FAIL. It runs under the shared fence (RI45-20) and writes by exclusive create.
recommendation.reasoning: The consumer contract copies entries from the actual native admitted_points under root custody (HANDOFF_CONTRACT_CX3V002). Labels, self-hashes, FINISHED monitors and PRELAUNCH permits do not show admission (RULES_AUDIT sections 1, 3 and 4; Claude3 0094: 219/219 admission cases as predicted). (b) puts custody on a manual step exactly where target-free provenance matters. (c) gives reviewed step-6 code (Claude4 0071 PASS) a new role and a new review. Calling the two native functions unchanged confines the new review to the comparison and the emitter.

Padding a fourth entry would break the consumer's copied-native-u rule. FORMAL (Claude3 0094 CX-SF3): the shared coordinate file does not distinguish the two modes.

It binds the mode name and the exact coordinate-addendum and config identity, not only the shared coordinate file; keeps theta_natural as the mapping input; and validates distance_Mpc = 4.04 as fixed.
(b) A reviewed explicit bridge that maps the three-u vector to four entries and records the mapping.
(c) Run step 4 in the four-u, distance-varying mode.

recommendation.text: (a). MUST_FAIL controls: a four-u point under the three-u mode; a mode or addendum mismatch; distance_Mpc other than 4.04; a three-u point with an invented fourth entry.

The filler already maps the physics from theta (gamma = gamma_over_Eref x Eref_base_J; the DDO distance never reaches the NGC geometry, which stays 13.8 Mpc and 72 degrees; HANDOFF_CONTRACT_CX3V002), so u serves validation only.
